remoteDesktop.guacdUnavailable: Remote desktop service (guacd) is not available. Please ensure guacd is running and accessible and configured properly in admin settings.
remoteDesktop.credentialPromptDescription: This host is set to prompt for credentials on connect. They are used for this session only and are not saved.

files.title: Drive Files
files.uploadDisabled: Uploads are disabled for this connection
files.driveUnavailable: Enable RDP drive redirection before uploading files
files.driveNotWritable: guacd cannot write to the drive folder. Check GUACD_DRIVE_PATH (or the host's Drive Path) and its permissions.

toolbar.hide: Hide for this session. To disable it permanently, open Host Settings → General → Connection Toolbar.
toolbar.switchToTrackpad: Switch to trackpad mode (drag to move cursor, tap to click)
toolbar.switchToTouch: Switch to touch mode (tap directly where you want to click)

remoteDesktop.disabled: Remote Desktop is turned off. An admin can turn it on in Settings.

hosts.nativeRdpFailed: Failed to open Windows Remote Desktop

guac.authTypeNoneDesc: No credentials are stored. You'll be prompted for a username and password each time you connect; they are not saved.
guac.loadBalanceInfoDesc: RD Connection Broker cookie for RDS farm load balancing (e.g. tsv://MS Terminal Services Plugin.1.CollectionName)
guac.guacdProxyDesc: Override the global guacd instance for this connection. Leave blank to use the globally configured guacd.
guac.ignoreCertificateDesc: Allow connections to hosts with self-signed certificates
guac.forceLosslessDesc: Force lossless image encoding (higher quality, more bandwidth)
guac.disableAudioDesc: Mute all audio from the remote session
guac.enableAudioInputDesc: Forward local microphone to the remote session
guac.menuAnimationsDesc: Enable menu fade and slide animations
guac.disableBitmapCachingDesc: Turn off bitmap cache (may help with glitches)
guac.enablePrintingDesc: Redirect local printers to the remote session
guac.enableDriveRedirectionDesc: Map a local folder as a drive in the remote session
guac.createDrivePathDesc: Automatically create the folder if it does not exist
guac.disableDownloadDesc: Prevent downloading files from the remote session
guac.disableUploadDesc: Prevent uploading files to the remote session
guac.consoleSessionDesc: Connect to the console (session 0) instead of a new session
guac.sendWolPacketDesc: Send a magic packet to wake this host before connecting
guac.disableCopyDesc: Prevent copying text from the remote session
guac.disablePasteDesc: Prevent pasting text into the remote session
guac.excludeOutputDesc: Do not record screen output (metadata only)
guac.includeKeystrokesDesc: Record raw keystrokes in addition to screen output
guac.swapRedBlueDesc: Swap the red and blue color channels (fixes some colour issues)
guac.readOnlyDesc: View the remote screen without sending any input

hosts.userDefaultsNote: Settings left on their default use your Remote Desktop defaults from Settings.
hosts.connectionOriginNote: On the desktop app, RDP, VNC and Telnet use the remote server unless the host is set to This device, which needs a guacd this machine can reach. Set one in the Remote Desktop settings, or per host under guacd Proxy.

onboarding.feature_desktop_desc: Open RDP, VNC and Telnet sessions in a tab, same as SSH.

colorDepth.label: Color Depth
colorDepth.description: Used for RDP hosts that leave it on their default.

resizeMethod.label: Resize Method
resizeMethod.description: How the remote screen follows the window size.

forceLossless.label: Force Lossless
forceLossless.description: Force lossless image encoding (higher quality, more bandwidth)

disableAudio.label: Disable Audio
disableAudio.description: Mute all audio from the remote session

enablePrinting.label: Enable Printing
enablePrinting.description: Redirect local printers to the remote session

enableDrive.label: Enable Drive Redirection
enableDrive.description: Map a local folder as a drive in the remote session

disableCopy.label: Disable Copy
disableCopy.description: Prevent copying text from the remote session

disablePaste.label: Disable Paste
disablePaste.description: Prevent pasting text into the remote session

enabled.label: Enable Remote Desktop
enabled.description: Allow RDP, VNC and Telnet connections through guacd.

guacdUrl.label: guacd URL
guacdUrl.description: Where guacd listens, as host:port. The GUACD_URL, GUACD_HOST and GUACD_PORT environment variables override this.

enableToolbar.label: Remote desktop toolbar
enableToolbar.description: Show the toolbar in RDP, VNC and Telnet sessions.

sessions.title: Share remote desktop sessions
sessions.description: Let session sharing and collab rooms show this user's RDP, VNC and Telnet sessions to others.
